Pricing FAQ

Common questions about our pricing and plans

Is there really a free plan?

Yes! Our free plan includes identity verification, public trust profile, basic work confirmations, and dispute resolution. We believe everyone deserves to build trust, regardless of their budget.

How does the Pro plan help me earn more?

Pro users get advanced analytics to understand their reputation growth, privacy controls to manage their profile, priority dispute support for faster resolution, and custom branding to look more professional. These features help attract more customers and command better rates.

When will Business features be available?

Business features like team management and API access are in development. Join our waitlist to get early access and help shape these features based on your business needs.

Can I change plans anytime?

Yes, you can upgrade or downgrade your plan at any time. If you upgrade, you'll be charged the difference. If you downgrade, you'll keep the higher plan features until your billing period ends.

What payment methods do you accept?

We accept bKash, Nagad, Rocket, and major credit/debit cards. For Business plans, we also accept bank transfers and corporate payment methods.
